purpose: Exploratory screening of temporal-reference contamination and recovery; not revival of rejected interval-tail claim

models.reason: Keep the old model as a boundary/negative control
Different state sensitivities and dynamic coupling make recovery of cooperative information operationally relevant; declared before new results

reference_rule.reset: previous packet's independent spatial statistic ratio > 1 disables temporal evidence for the current packet

single_step: Attack the first actual packet in the declared attack window once
alternating: Alternate full and 0.25 times fixed bias on successive actual packets; tests resetting/weak-payload acceptance vulnerability
normal_target: 5% new-packet weight<0.5 on independent normal validation; report achieved weights and normal MSE
primary_recovery: Attacked receiver MSE for 10 estimate updates after first unsubstituted post-attack received packet; source still may have indirect contamination
novelty_gate: A complex rule is not promoted unless it improves receiver recovery by >=5% over raw-reference AND >=2% over both simple reset and spatial-only on at least 2 of single_step/step/replay_matched, with normal and attack-window MSE degradation <=2%; per-case intervals are exploratory
limitations: Mechanism screening, not publication novelty proof; original full-local model remains; new sensing model justified before testing; Berman2014 full text still needed
